Engineering & Compliance

Built for Safety & Extreme Climates

Every QIANFAN device undergoes multi-stage thermal aging and electrical safety inspection prior to retail packaging.

01

Smart IC Thermal Protection

Our 120W car chargers integrate intelligent temperature-control chips and UL94 V-0 fire-retardant housings to prevent over-voltage, over-current, and short circuits even inside parked vehicles under Gulf summer sun.

02

Ultrasonic Nano-Atomization

High-frequency microporous atomizing plates convert clean water into 5-micron cooling mist particles that evaporate instantaneously on contact with warm air, delivering rapid evaporative cooling.

03

International Certifications

All products comply with CE, FCC, and RoHS directives, accompanied by UN38.3 battery safety reports and authentic GS1 EAN-13 retail barcodes for seamless e-commerce fulfillment.

About The Brand

Setting Sail Toward Smarter Everyday Electronics

Founded with a commitment to practical innovation and industrial durability, QIANFAN develops reliable consumer electronics tailored for modern commuting and warm-climate lifestyles. Inspired by the spirit of navigating forward ("Qianfan" — a thousand sails), our engineering team focuses on solving real daily pain points: tangled car charging cables and intense summer heat.

From our 120W 4-in-1 retractable fast car chargers to our 4-speed ultrasonic misting fans, every QIANFAN product is produced in ISO-certified manufacturing facilities with strict component traceability, permanent brand identity markings, and dedicated after-sales customer care.
